Study

Undergraduate & Postgraduate
Undergraduate & Postgraduate
At the School of Biomedical Sciences we nurture talents and empower the next generation of scientists, doctors, innovators and healthcare professionals. Through our diverse, hands-on and dynamic study programs covering biomedicine, bioinformatics, clinical science and health technology, students develop essential skills to make fundamental discoveries and tackle current and emerging health challenges.
Research
Research
Research Areas
Research Areas
Our faculty pushes the boundaries of knowledge in neuroscience, cancer, genomic sciences, immunology, stem cell biology and synthetic biology to advance cures and promote healthy aging. Backed by substantial funding and national initiatives, we drive innovative solutions to pressing health challenges and shape the future of global health sciences.
About
About
Shaping the future of healthcare and society, SBMS pioneers innovative research, develops future leaders, and fosters entrepreneurship. Through exceptional teaching, research and industry engagement, we drive transformative solutions that make a global impact.
